english.title: Person on a ship in relevant marine area introduce live animal / plant with natural range not in GB
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), whilst on board a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP..), in a relevant part of the marine area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MARINE AREA..), deliberately introduced into that area a live

(A)_[animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),]_
(B)_[plant, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLANT..),]_

of a kind having a natural range which did not include any area in Great Britain
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 54(1) and (7) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.

english.notes: Regulation 54(8) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 provides that section 14 of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 (introduction of new species etc.) does not apply in relation to any act which is an offence under this regulation.
